_doc: INTENTS1: the REAL mainnet intents.near call surface our code depends on. Source: github.com/near/intents rev 16d04f6ec4401263f8914638710260da50bb46b0 (the rev intents.near itself reports via contract_source_metadata: version 0.4.5), cross-checked 2026-11-10 with free mainnet view calls (a change method called in view mode panics on arg deserialization / 1 yocto BEFORE anything else, and an absent method returns MethodNotFound). Tests in apps/web/tests and services/relayer/test check every call we build against this file; mock-intents mirrors it. Update only from the deployed source.

mt_transfer.evidence: contracts/defuse/src/contract/tokens/nep245/core.rs mt_transfer -> mt_batch_transfer (assert_one_yocto; approvals.is_none()); internal_mt_batch_transfer (sender==receiver or amount==0 -> InvalidIntent). View probe: 'Requires attached deposit of exactly 1 yoctoNEAR'; amount as JSON number -> 'invalid type: integer, expected a string'.

rules: receiver.mt_on_transfer(sender_id, previous_owner_ids=[sender_id], token_ids, amounts, msg) gets all remaining gas
mt_resolve_transfer (15 Tgas reserved) refunds what mt_on_transfer returns
mt_transfer_call.evidence: nep245/core.rs mt_transfer_call / notify_and_resolve_transfer / notify_on_transfer; nep245/resolver.rs mt_resolve_transfer. View probe: 'Requires attached deposit of exactly 1 yoctoNEAR'.

rules: token is the BARE NEP-141 contract id (AccountId; 'nep141:' prefix fails to deserialize)
storage_deposit: None -> receiver must already be registered on the token or the ft_transfer fails and ft_resolve_withdraw re-credits the intents balance
msg set -> ft_transfer_call (failed call is NOT refunded)
wNEAR comes out as wNEAR (no unwrap)
ft_withdraw.evidence: contracts/defuse/src/contract/tokens/nep141/withdraw.rs. View probe with {token:'wrap.near',...}: 'Requires attached deposit of exactly 1 yoctoNEAR'; with token 'nep141:wrap.near': 'the Account ID contains an invalid character ':' at index 6'.

ft_on_transfer.kind: receiver (called by the NEP-141 token on ft_transfer_call)
rules: msg starting with '{' -> JSON DepositMessage {receiver_id, execute_intents?, refund_if_fails?} (panics on bad JSON -> token refunds)
otherwise msg must parse as an AccountId (panics otherwise)
token id credited = 'nep141:' + predecessor (the token contract)
attached_deposit debited from the signer's wNEAR intents balance (not refunded on failure)

token_ids_confirmed._doc: mt_supply(token_id) non-null on intents.near 2026-11-10 (a wrong format, e.g. bare 'wrap.near', returns null). intents.near is storage-registered on every one of these NEP-141 contracts (storage_balance_of non-null).
